articles.summary: AUSTIN, Texas, March 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- EZCORP, Inc. (“EZCORP” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: EZPW), a leading provider of pawn transactions in the United States and Latin America, will host its Annual Meeting of Stockholders on Thursday, March 26, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. Central Time.
articles.title: EZCORP to Host Annual Meeting of Stockholders on Thursday, March 26, 2026
